description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

World Wide Technology is a global technology solutions provider delivering innovative IT solutions for government and commercial clients. The company is seeking a Cloud Developer to support USTRANSCOM and associated COOCMs by developing and maintaining cloud-native code, executing AWS and GitLab CI/CD pipelines, preparing change requests, documenting technical work, and collaborating with senior developers.
Junior AWS Cloud Developer building infrastructure-as-code, containerized services, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment documentation

Responsibilities:
• This role focuses on feature development, executing automated pipelines, peer collaboration, and adhering to strict deployment processes. A Junior-to-Mid Level 2 Developer takes a well-defined Jira ticket, writes the code, submits a clean Merge Request, and reliably follows the established Change Request process to get it deployed using existing GitLab pipelines. They function primarily as builders and maintainers rather than system architects
• Deploys and manages AWS resources using IaC principles. Preferred experience using Terraform or CloudFormation
• Experience with containerized environments and orchestration. Preferred experience using ECS with Fargate or Rancher RKE2
• Executes existing AWS Systems Manager (SSM) Documents for routine operations and securely retrieves configurations/secrets using Parameter Store. Experience with Ansible is a plus
• Monitors and triggers GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Capable of reading pipeline logs to troubleshoot basic build/test failures before escalating to senior engineers. Preferred experience using GitLab Pipelines
• Familiarity with managing resources across multiple accounts and regions using AWS StackSets
• Submits functional code via Merge Requests (MRs). Actively participates in code reviews by addressing feedback promptly and reviewing peers' code for basic logic and syntax
• Drafts the initial framework for Change Requests (CRs). Gathers the necessary artifacts (test results, implementation steps) and prepares them for senior review and CAB approval
• Takes ownership of their sprint work in Jira (updating statuses daily). Contributes to Confluence by updating technical documentation, API specs, and team runbooks based on completed work
• Write, test, and maintain cloud-native code and scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, JSON) targeting AWS environments
• Run and monitor code through GitLab CI/CD pipelines, ensuring tests and security scans pass before merging
• Follow structured operational processes by drafting accurate Change Requests (CRs) for all production deployments
• Ensure all developed features have accompanying technical documentation and updated operational runbooks in Confluence
• Work closely with senior developers to break down complex Jira stories into actionable technical tasks

Requirements:
• Secret Clearance
• 1 – 3 years years of prior relevant experience
• DoD8140 DCWF (Cloud +)
• Security +
• Infrastructure as Code: Deploys and manages AWS resources using IaC principles
• Container Experience: Experience with containerized environments and orchestration
• Configuration Management: Executes existing AWS Systems Manager (SSM) Documents for routine operations and securely retrieves configurations/secrets using Parameter Store
• Pipelines: Monitors and triggers GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Capable of reading pipeline logs to troubleshoot basic build/test failures before escalating to senior engineers
• Familiarity with managing resources across multiple accounts and regions using AWS StackSets
• Git & Merge Requests: Submits functional code via Merge Requests (MRs). Actively participates in code reviews by addressing feedback promptly and reviewing peers' code for basic logic and syntax
• Agile (Jira/Confluence): Takes ownership of their sprint work in Jira (updating statuses daily). Contributes to Confluence by updating technical documentation, API specs, and team runbooks based on completed work

Preferred:
• AWS certificate preferred
• Preferred experience using Terraform or CloudFormation
• Preferred experience using ECS with Fargate or Rancher RKE2
• Experience with Ansible is a plus
• Preferred experience using GitLab Pipelines
